title: Pickin' in the Park - Weekly Bluegrass Jam
description: Bring an instrument or a lawn chair. Weekly outdoor bluegrass jam every Tuesday evening through summer.

title: Rosalie Haizlett: Wildflowers of Appalachia Workshop
description: Half-day watercolor and pen workshop. All materials provided. Beginners welcome. Includes a guided ID walk along the Tygart River.

title: Kevin Woodcock Solo Exhibition Opening
description: Opening reception June 13. New oil paintings of Randolph County landscapes. Exhibition runs through July.

title: Gandy Dancer Theatre: Bright Star
description: Steve Martin and Edie Brickell's bluegrass musical. Friday & Saturday evenings, Sunday matinee.

title: First Friday Art Walk - July
description: Galleries and studios open late, live music in the streets, food trucks. First Friday of every month.

title: Ceramics with Class - Drop-in Pottery Night
description: Two-hour intro pottery session. No experience needed. Leave with a piece to be fired and picked up later.
